verdict.rationale: A direct probe found a live llms.txt at docs.coderabbit.ai that indexes the docs as agent-readable markdown links. Many cited doc pages are also served as .md URLs (e.g. /overview/pull-request-review.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing llms.txt or the markdown docs for agent use (e.g. an llms-full.txt or usage guide).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
